interpolation.description: Error of the Chebyshev interpolants at $\epsilon_0$

element_phase.description: Phase change of $\mathcal M(\epsilon)$ in the parallel-transport gauge

gap_min.description: Smallest $\Delta E$ over the drive at $A/\Omega=8$

gap_max.description: Largest $\Delta E$ over the drive at $A/\Omega=8$

element_min.description: Smallest $\lvert\mathcal M\rvert$ over the drive at $A/\Omega=8$

element_max.description: Largest $\lvert\mathcal M\rvert$ over the drive at $A/\Omega=8$

weight_minus.description: Floquet weight $w_{-1}$ at $A/\Omega=8$, in units of the static strength

weight_zero.description: Floquet weight $w_0$ at $A/\Omega=8$, in units of the static strength

weight_plus.description: Floquet weight $w_{+1}$ at $A/\Omega=8$, in units of the static strength

asymmetry_constant_element.description: Adiabatic asymmetry with constant $\mathcal M$ at $A/\Omega=8$

asymmetry_linear_gap.description: Adiabatic asymmetry with linearized $\Delta E$ at $A/\Omega=8$

tien_gordon_zero.description: Simple Tien–Gordon weight $J_0^2(\Delta n A/\Omega)$ at $A/\Omega=8$

tien_gordon_one.description: Simple Tien–Gordon weight $J_1^2(\Delta n A/\Omega)$ of $q=\pm1$ at $A/\Omega=8$

tien_gordon_check.description: Adiabatic formula with linear $\Delta E$ and constant $\mathcal M$ minus $J_q^2(\Delta n A/\Omega)$

total_weight.description: Floquet weight summed over $q$ at $A/\Omega=8$, in units of the static strength

total_weight_adiabatic.description: Period average of $\lvert\mathcal M\rvert^2$ at $A/\Omega=8$, in units of the static strength

max_deviation_adiabatic.description: Largest difference of Floquet and adiabatic weights, $\lvert q\rvert\le3$
